note: The built-in inverse-time families, restated as data so the constants and their source are on record. The loader checks every constant against the equation in code and refuses a mismatch. IEC form: t = TMS * k / ((I/Is)^alpha - 1). IEEE form: t = TD * (a / ((I/Is)^p - 1) + b).
